Based on my configuration, I have access to these tools:

## Core Tools

1. **read** - Read file contents
   - Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp)
   - Can read partial files with offset/limit for large files

2. **bash** - Execute bash commands
   - Run any shell command (ls, grep, find, npm, git, etc.)
   - Get stdout and stderr output
   - Can set timeouts

3. **edit** - Make precise file edits
   - Uses exact text replacement
   - Can make multiple targeted edits in one call
   - Good for updating existing code

4. **write** - Create or overwrite files
   - Write complete file content
   - Automatically creates parent directories
   - Best for new files or complete rewrites

## What I Can Do With These

- Browse and search your codebase
- Run development servers, tests, builds
- Install packages (npm, yarn, pnpm)
- Execute git commands
- Read documentation and config files
- Write and edit React components
- Debug code by running it
- Work with TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, etc.

## What I Cannot Do

- Web search / internet access
- Access external APIs (unless through bash/code)
- Video/audio processing
- Direct database access
